# A report states the model and the revision that produced it

The revision of the clause whose premise collapsed, and still in trial: nothing
has accepted it, so it is not in force and UZ-V-003 keeps binding until it is.
That is what pending_successor reports on UZ-V-003 — a fact about a change in
flight rather than a fault — and what keeps status_drift quiet.
